preserve_original_in: food photo originals folder (photo_ingest creates it)
record_in: provenance table beside the originals; scores in t1-results.csv or sessions/results.csv
command: python3 tools/photo_ingest.py ingest ... then t1_record.py / session_record.py report
claude_does: hash, QA flags, sort by run/construction/hold time; compare with the AI concept (what the render got right/wrong); never edit originals
never_do: enhance, beautify, add garnish, infer measurements from photos

input_kind: RECEIPT or PACKAGE or LABEL PHOTO
record_in: ops/templates/expenses-receipts.csv; ingredient price into food/costing/ingredients.csv as price_class RETAIL RECEIPT
command: python3 tools/intake.py preserve KIND files ; record-purchase JSON ; apply-prices JSON
claude_does: read the image directly, extract only what is visible, mark the rest NOT OBSERVED, ask only for missing items that matter, note the D-54 label result
never_do: invent a price, brand, size or lot; treat a retail receipt as a supplier quote

command: python3 tools/intake.py preserve quote files ; record-quote JSON
claude_does: record vendor, date, product, pack, price, MOQ, delivery, lead time, terms, validity, spec and D-54 concerns, confidence
never_do: convert a directory listing, search snippet, retail price or assumption into a quote; extrapolate one quote into a market price

what_arrives: reply to the brewer send pack and form
record_in: docs/professional-reviews/RECORD-TEMPLATE.md copy; beer matrix and briefs only after analysis
claude_does: separate what confirms, contradicts agent advice, needs revision, needs testing, needs regulatory check; professional outranks agent on brewing
never_do: treat the brewer's view as fact outside brewing (law, finance, culture)

what_arrives: reply to the advisor send pack and form
record_in: docs/professional-reviews/ record; claims and names updated only after classification (ACCEPT/REVISE/INVESTIGATE/DISAGREE/FOUNDER DECISION)
claude_does: keep Indian and Mexican reviews independent; keep cultural advice separate from historical verification
never_do: turn advice into verified history; cherry-pick positive comments

record_in: docs/professional-reviews/ record; decisions in DECISIONS.md; regulatory-question-tree.csv status
claude_does: record exact question, jurisdiction, date, assumptions, limits and next step; supersede D-78/D-79 only through a new decision with the founder
never_do: paraphrase a cautious answer as clearance; give legal advice; assume a general answer is NASHA-specific

preserve_original_in: paper originals stay outside git; consent noted
claude_does: transcribe only what is written; code with the coding system; keep n and cohort; directional only
never_do: count friends or synthetic data as validation

what_arrives: quote or terms from a kitchen or venue
record_in: vendor-rfq-comparison.csv; ops/finance/scenario-fields inputs (assumptions.csv with provenance class QUOTE)
command: python3 tools/intake.py preserve quote files ; record-quote JSON
claude_does: separate hourly rate, minimums, insurance and permit requirements
never_do: treat a listing price as a quote

what_arrives: reply or quote on Glass V2
record_in: capex-quotes.csv and a glass decision record
claude_does: compare against specs.json assumptions; do not generate Glass V3 without feedback
never_do: treat a quote as manufacturability proof beyond what they state

input_kind: Founder photograph of a real cook (prototype media)
what_arrives: Original phone photos of a real cook, unedited
record_in: visuals/FOUNDER-PROTOTYPE-MEDIA.csv (the site build shows it with its stage label)
claude_does: Preserve the original, fill the media row from what the photo shows and the founder says (food, date, iteration), rebuild the private site, update the iteration log
never_do: Edit or enhance the photograph; register concept or AI images here; call it validated before the dish passes its gates
